method: Computer Use through native Windows UI in an isolated synthetic fixture
observations: The ordinary fixture page retained its content while the browser frame used the new dark teal accent. Native window titles ended with Xenon; website tab labels remained unchanged.

Xenon Controls displayed the rounded navy/teal logo in its title bar and header, a navy brand header, pale slate canvas, white grouped cards and teal section headings. Main controls and status text were readable without visible overlap at the tested size.

Clicked the synthetic Draft input, waited for its pause to end, and appended human edit. The harness independently verified a new keyboard activity epoch and pause while preserving owner, generation and the draft.

Clicked Confirm synthetic logout; Controls surfaced with the exact fixture selected and the agent labelled paused for you. The pause persisted until clicking the restyled Dismiss button, and fixture telemetry verified one dismissal.

Controls retained Take ownership, Give to agent, Remove workspace, shared-vault labels and Fill saved account. Chromium native menu features remained available; its inherited About Chromium label is still present.
Used the native browser menu Exit in the separate startup fixture. The harness verified ordinary blank restart, retained workspace storage and no automatic old-page loads.
limits: No real website, saved password or existing user profile was used.
This check does not verify human account-picker interaction, Save/Update prompts, automatic autofill suggestions or PD Portal.
Only the current desktop scale and theme were visually checked; high-contrast, light mode, multi-monitor/DPI and Explorer icon-cache behavior need wider manual coverage.
Workspace removal was not approved through the UI.
